objectives: Decide when a vehicle sale needs notarially certified signatures.
Carry out the checks that the law requires before the certification.
Calculate the notarial fee and the local tax for a vehicle sale.
Complete the file: the information system, the notice to the municipality and the buyer's registration.

cards.front: Which vehicles need notarially certified signatures on the sale contract?
cards.back: Registered **cars**, **trailers over 10 t**, **wheeled tractors**, **motorcycles over 350 cm³** ([[zdvp:144:2]]).

cards.front: Name the exceptions from the certification requirement.
cards.back: End-of-life vehicles; vehicles whose acquirer is abroad without a later Bulgarian registration; vehicles deregistered after a total loss ([[zdvp:144:2]]).

cards.front: A car registered in Varna is sold by a seller who lives in Sofia. Which notary may certify the contract?
cards.back: **Any** notary: a certification of signatures is not bound to a district ([[gpk:570:2]]).

cards.front: What does the notary check about the vehicle tax?
cards.back: That the **seller paid** the vehicle tax, through the Ministry of Finance system or a municipal document ([[dopk:264:2]]).

cards.front: What is the material interest for the fee on a car sale?
cards.back: The value for which the vehicle is **insured** ([[znnd:97:1]]), or the price when it is higher ([[znnd:97:3|Art. 97(3)]]).

cards.front: Which tariff item applies to a car sale?
What does the notary enter in the information system after a car sale?
cards.back: A **scan** of the contract; the office keeps a copy with the representation documents and the declarations for **two years** ([[n32:9а::6|Art. 9а item 6 Наредба № 32]]).

cards.front: What is the deadline for the buyer to register the car?
The seller paid the vehicle tax for the whole year. Does the buyer pay it again?
cards.back: **No**: the new owner does not pay the tax when the previous owner paid it until the end of the calendar year ([[zmdt:58:3]]).

cards.front: Can a person without a Bulgarian address buy a registered car directly?
cards.back: Only after the registration is **terminated** and the plates are returned ([[zdvp:144:3]]).

cards.front: What form does a power of attorney to sell a car need?
cards.back: A **notarially certified signature**, because the power follows the form of the deal ([[zzd:37]], first sentence).

cards.front: A power of attorney to sell a car was certified by a mayor. Is it valid?
cards.back: **Yes**: a mayor may certify signatures where the settlement has no notary and no district court ([[znnd:83:1]]); mayors cannot enter the power in the information system (Council of Notaries, January 2024; chapter 5).

quiz.question: A motorcycle with a 250 cm³ engine is sold. Must the signatures be notarially certified?
options: No; the rule covers motorcycles over 350 cm³
Yes; the rule covers all registered motorcycles
Yes; the rule covers all registered vehicles
Only when the price of the motorcycle is over 5,000 €
quiz.explanation: [[zdvp:144:2]] requires certified signatures for registered cars, trailers over 10 t, wheeled tractors and motorcycles with an engine over 350 cm³. A 250 cm³ motorcycle is sold by a written contract ([[zdvp:144:1|Art. 144(1)]]); the price plays no role.

quiz.question: A car registered in Varna is sold by a seller in Sofia. Which notary may certify the contract?
options: Any notary in the country
Only a notary in Varna
Only a notary in Sofia
Only the notary at the buyer's address
quiz.explanation: [[gpk:570:2]]: notarial acts other than deeds for real estate are performed by any notary, whatever the link between the district and the act. The district rule of [[gpk:570:1|Art. 570(1)]] applies only to real estate.

quiz.question: What must the notary check about the seller before certifying a car sale?
options: The paid vehicle tax and the public debts of the seller
The income of the seller and the origin of the car
The penalty points on the driving licence of the seller
Only the identity of the seller and the registration certificate
quiz.explanation: [[dopk:264:2]]: a vehicle is transferred after a check in the Ministry of Finance system that the vehicle tax is paid ([[zmdt:50:2]]) and after the check of the seller's public debts under [[dopk:264:1|Art. 264(1)]]. The registration certificate identifies the car, but it is not the check the law requires.

quiz.question: The car is insured for 12,000 €; the price is 9,000 €. What is the material interest for the fee?
options: 12,000 €, the insured value
9,000 €, the agreed price
10,500 €, the average of the two
The market price set by the notary
quiz.explanation: [[znnd:97:1:1|Art. 97(1) item 1 ЗННД]]: for a deal with a vehicle the material interest is the value for which it is insured; [[znnd:97:3|Art. 97(3)]]: in an onerous deal the price applies only when it is higher. Here the insured value is higher.

quiz.question: A car insured for 4,000 € is sold for 3,500 €. What is the notarial fee without VAT?
quiz.explanation: The base is the insured value, the higher amount ([[znnd:97:1|Art. 97(1)]] and [[znnd:97:3|(3) ЗННД]]): 4,000 € = 7,823.32 лв. [[tarifa:11|Item 11]] applies [[tarifa:8|item 8]], bracket 1,001–10,000 лв.: 43.50 + 1.3% × 6,823.32 = 132.20 лв. = 67.59 €. 101.70 is 1.3% of the whole base; 43.50 is the fixed part alone.

quiz.question: What does the office do with the signed contract in the information system?
options: Enters a scan of the contract at once
Enters only the price and the parties
Enters nothing; the buyer registers the car
Sends the contract to the municipality
quiz.explanation: [[n32:9а::6|Art. 9а item 6 of Ordinance No. 32]]: the notary enters and sends at once to the information system of the Chamber a scanned copy of the contract certified under [[zdvp:144:2]]. The municipality receives a separate notice under [[zmdt:51:2]].

quiz.question: How long does the notary keep the copy of the contract and the declarations in a special file?
options: Two years
Ten years
One hundred years
Six months
quiz.explanation: [[n32:9а::6|Art. 9а item 6 of Ordinance No. 32]]: the notary keeps in a special office file, for two years, a copy of the contract, the documents proving the representative power of the parties and their declarations under the law.

quiz.question: Within what time must the buyer register the car?
options: One month
Two weeks
Three months
One year
quiz.explanation: [[zdvp:145:2]]: the acquirer of a registered vehicle registers it within one month at the registration office of the owner's permanent address, unless a dealer acquired it for resale.

quiz.question: The buyer wants to pay 7,000 € in cash. Is it allowed?
options: No; from 10,000 лв. (5,112.92 €) the payment goes through an account
Yes; the limit of the law does not apply to sales of vehicles
Yes, if the notary counts the money and notes it in the contract
Yes, if the parties write the cash payment in the contract
quiz.explanation: [[zopvb:3:1]]: payments of 10,000 лв. or more are made only by transfer or deposit to a payment account; 7,000 € is above that limit. There is no exception for vehicles, and a note in the contract changes nothing.

quiz.question: The car belongs to a married couple as common property; only the husband comes. What is the risk?
options: The wife can challenge the sale, as for common real estate
None; the buyer of a movable acquires it in good faith
The sale is void by law, without a court claim
The buyer becomes co-owner of the car with the wife
quiz.explanation: [[sk:24:5]]: for a disposal that needs certified signatures, [[sk:24:4|Art. 24(4)]] applies as for real estate: the other spouse may challenge the sale in court within six months of learning of it, but not later than three years. The good-faith rule for movables applies only to deals without certified signatures.

quiz.question: Within what time does the notary notify the municipality about the car sale?
options: 7 days from the deal
1 month from the deal
2 months from the deal
Never; the buyer notifies it
quiz.explanation: [[zmdt:51:2]]: within 7 days of the deal the notary notifies the municipality of the transferred real rights in real estate and vehicles, with the paid tax and its base.

quiz.question: A buyer without a permanent address in Bulgaria wants to buy a registered car in Sofia. What is the procedure?
options: The registration is terminated and the plates returned; then the contract is certified
The contract is certified; the buyer registers the car within one month
The contract is certified; the car keeps its plates until the buyer exports it
The sale is not possible; the car must first be sold to a Bulgarian dealer
quiz.explanation: [[zdvp:144:3]]: a registered vehicle is transferred to a person without a permanent address or address registration in Bulgaria under [[zdvp:144:2|Art. 144(2)]] after the registration is terminated and the plates are returned to the registration office.
